title: Barcelona to the Costa Brava
structure: W Barcelona (3 nights) → Costa Brava (2 nights) → Le Méridien Barcelona (1 night + departure)

days.label: Tue Aug 11
days.theme: Arrival, Gothic Quarter, El Born & Flamenco

events.title: Arrive at BCN
events.details: Barcelona-El Prat Airport. Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage, and transfer to the hotel.

events.title: W Barcelona
events.details: Drop luggage if room not ready. No timed attractions this morning.

events.title: Beachfront Walk
events.details: Walk along Sant Sebastià Beach and Barceloneta promenade. Light snack or drink. Relaxed first look at Barcelona.

events.title: Lunch in Barceloneta
events.details: First proper meal: croquetas, pan con tomate, grilled fish, tapas. Save the big paella for later.

events.title: W Reset
events.details: Room check-in, shower, quick refresh before heading out.

events.title: Gothic Quarter
events.details: Plaça Reial → Carrer del Call → Plaça Sant Jaume → Cathedral → Pont del Bisbe → Plaça del Rei → Temple of Augustus.

events.title: El Born
events.details: Santa Maria del Mar, Passeig del Born, Carrer de Montcada. Browse boutiques and galleries. End up at Palau Dalmases.

events.title: Flamenco
events.details: Palau Dalmases. Intimate show in a 17th-century baroque palace. Zone A seating. Montcada, 20.

events.title: Dinner
events.details: Tapas-focused dinner in El Born's atmospheric streets.

events.title: Return to W
events.details: Walk toward the harbour, then taxi back.

days.label: Wed Aug 12
days.theme: Gaudí, Gràcia & Casa Batlló Magical Night

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Relaxed breakfast at the hotel.

events.title: Sagrada Família
events.details: See the basilica and walk around the exterior. Roughly an hour is plenty if exterior-only.

events.title: Avinguda de Gaudí
events.details: Tree-lined pedestrian boulevard northwest from Sagrada Família.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Eat near Sagrada / lower Gràcia before continuing west.

events.title: Gràcia
events.details: Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia, Carrer de Verdi, surrounding side streets. Village-like, away from tourist monuments.

events.title: La Pedrera / Passeig de Gràcia
events.details: Casa Milà exterior, walk south along Passeig de Gràcia. Interior tour optional.

events.title: W Pool & Rest
events.details: Taxi back. Pool, beach, shower, nap. The evening becomes its own event.

events.title: Snack & Get Ready
events.details: No major dinner — Casa Batlló runs until ~22:00. Main dinner comes after.

events.title: Taxi to Casa Batlló
events.details: Comfortable buffer. Exterior photos before entry.

events.title: Casa Batlló Magical Nights
events.details: 20:00: building visit. 21:00: rooftop concert. ~22:00: concludes. Passeig de Gràcia, 43.

events.title: Late Dinner
events.details: Proper dinner in Eixample after the show. One of Barcelona's best restaurant areas.

events.title: Return to W
events.details: Taxi back to the waterfront.

days.label: Thu Aug 13
days.theme: Park Güell, Montjuïc, W Beach Afternoon & Barceloneta Evening

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Last morning at the W before Costa Brava tomorrow.

events.title: Montjuïc
events.details: MNAC viewpoint, Olympic area, gardens, miradors, skyline views.

events.title: Coffee in Gràcia
events.details: Head to Gràcia for coffee and a pastry before Park Güell.

events.title: Park Güell
events.details: Monumental Zone, Hypostyle Room, serpentine mosaic bench, city viewpoints. Entry at 12:30.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Eat near the park or walk down into upper Gràcia.

events.title: W Beach & Pool
events.details: Taxi back. Pool, beach, spa, drinks. Transition toward the coastal vacation.

events.title: Barceloneta Walk
events.details: Walk from W along beachfront into the Barceloneta neighbourhood.

events.title: Seafood Dinner
events.details: Grilled Mediterranean fish, gambas, croquetas, seafood rice, fideuà.

events.title: Walk back to W
events.details: Beachfront promenade. Last night at the W.

events.title: Breakfast & Pack
events.details: Final breakfast at the W. Check out.

events.title: Checkout & Car Pickup
events.details: Collect luggage, pick up rental car.

events.title: Drive to Begur
events.details: ~1.5–2 hours via AP-7 through the Catalan countryside.

events.title: Begur Arrival
events.details: Drop bags at hotel. Medieval hilltop town with castle and sea views.

events.title: Aiguablava
events.details: Crystal-clear water, pine-fringed cliffs. Swimming, snorkeling, kayaking. Do not rush.

events.title: Coastal Lunch
events.details: Long Mediterranean lunch overlooking the water.

events.title: Hotel & Siesta
events.details: Check in properly. Shower, rest.

events.title: Begur Old Town & Castle
events.details: Medieval streets. Walk up to castle for 360° views.

events.title: Dinner
events.details: Village square. Catalan cuisine, local Empordà wines.

days.label: Sat Aug 15
days.theme: Calella de Palafrugell, Camí de Ronda, Llafranc, Pals & Peratallada

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Morning meal before a full coastal day.

events.title: Calella de Palafrugell
events.details: Whitewashed fishing village, small beaches, Port Bo arcades.

events.title: Camí de Ronda
events.details: Coastal path Calella → Llafranc. Pine trails, turquoise coves, rocky headlands.

events.title: Llafranc
events.details: Crescent beach, marina, cafés. Lighthouse optional.

events.title: Seafood Lunch
events.details: Anchovies, gambas, suquet, fideuà. Eat with sea views.

events.title: Swim & Relax
events.details: Back in the water. No rushing.

events.title: Pals
events.details: Medieval hilltop village. Romanesque tower, cobblestones, views.

events.title: Peratallada
events.details: Honey-coloured stone, moat-carved streets. Stunning at golden hour.

events.title: Dinner
events.details: Eat in Peratallada or drive back to Begur.

days.label: Sun Aug 16
days.theme: Costa Brava → Le Méridien, Relaxed Final Barcelona Day

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Final morning on the coast.

events.title: Drive to Barcelona
events.details: AP-7 south. Return rental car.

events.title: Le Méridien Check-in
events.details: On La Rambla. Everything central is walkable.

events.title: Central Walk
events.details: Plaça Catalunya → La Rambla → Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Central Barcelona. Plenty of options near Le Méridien.

events.title: Hotel Break
events.details: Relax. Organize bags for departure.

events.title: Flexible Afternoon
events.details: A) Passeig de Gràcia shopping, B) El Born, C) Gothic Quarter, D) Palau de la Música, E) Port Vell sunset.

events.title: Farewell Dinner
events.details: Best dinner of the trip. Dress up, splurge, toast to the week.

events.title: Walk to Le Méridien
events.details: Through the illuminated Gothic Quarter and La Rambla.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: No rush. Final morning.

events.title: Final Walk
events.details: A) Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial → La Rambla. B) Plaça Catalunya → Passeig de Gràcia. Coffee, pastries, souvenirs.

events.title: Pack & Checkout
events.details: Final packing, collect luggage.

events.title: Airport
events.details: Taxi to BCN. Arrive ~3 hours before international departure.

toBook.title: Rental Car
toBook.detail: Pickup Fri morning, return Sun morning

toBook.title: Farewell Dinner
toBook.detail: Sunday evening, best meal of the trip
